scores.tell: Soft broad sheen and gentle form turn match; cup is slightly glossy on rim and saucer highlights.
Dark navy body with crisp hard glints on the truss pipes and a mild plasticky sheen; shading is a bit too dramatic and cool.
Smooth soft wood shading, gentle cast shadow on the floor; slightly flat faces, with little form turn on the posts.
Painterly soft-airbrushed plane shading with a blurry cast. Wing and cloud shadows are mushy, not crisp like the real cards.
Glossy plastic highlights on the phone and booth plus a heavy dark cast shadow. Reads a bit CG-rendered.
Flat, weak form turn on the stone pieces; scene lit like a 2D background with soft ambient-occlusion blobs and no clear key.
Soft broad highlights on the leather and strong warm bounce; very close to the grade-5 saddle, with only slightly bigger sheen on the seat.
Crisp white hot spots on the duck's head and body. Bright, but the form turn is smooth and the sand shadow is soft.
Glossy teal body with a hard bright specular streak on the edge, and chrome sheen on the bezels. Looks like shiny plastic.
Soft shading overall with a gentle glossy sheen on the rim; fairly close to real.
